goal: Remove the three agent-facing contract contradictions that make every Managed task reconcile a retired v3 playbook against the live v4 Assurance Kernel path, and add the missing consistency guard that allowed the largest one to drift. Rewrite the packaged imm-loop contract around the Kernel path (imm_loop_action route/dispatch_role and imm_kernel_canary advance_assurance/submit_review/request_authorization), deleting the retired imm-autowork checkpoint loop and the State Ledger authority section, and fix the self-contradicting review-gate paragraph in the plugin README. Delete the ctx_* tool usage mandate from AGENTS.md and drop the unused context-mode dependency, because no host provides those tools and no settings file activates the package. Delete the three CONTEXT.md vocabulary entries that have no live contract reference (State Ledger, promotion_criteria, Activation Plan), correct the two dead Python references to the shipped Bun runtime paths, and synchronize the BASELINE canonical-term list across its packaged copies. Add a consistency guard binding each public skills/*/SKILL.md to its packaged dist/imm-*.md, which is the only copy relationship in the repository without a sync check and therefore the one that drifted. Roadmap-family vocabulary, Fast-Track, Domain Mapper, Plan boundary, and Scope pressure stay in place because live contracts still reference them; the v3 runtime closure deletion, docs archival, and enrollment-flow redesign are deliberately out of scope for this slice.

acceptance.assertion: The packaged imm-loop contract no longer instructs agents to run the retired imm-autowork command or to treat the State Ledger as checkpoint authority, and instead describes the live Kernel path through imm_loop_action and imm_kernel_canary consistently with skills/imm-loop/SKILL.md; the plugin README no longer both claims imm-loop consumes imm-autowork and lists that command as retired.

AGENTS.md no longer mandates a context-mode tool hierarchy or any ctx_* tool that no configured host provides, and the unused context-mode dependency is removed from the package manifest and lockfile.

CONTEXT.md defines no vocabulary entry for State Ledger, promotion_criteria, or Activation Plan, references no imm-plan.py or activation_plan.py path, and every BASELINE copy states the same canonical-term list with State Ledger removed; Roadmap-family terms, Fast-Track, Domain Mapper, Plan boundary, and Scope pressure remain defined because live contracts still reference them.

A consistency guard fails when a public skills/*/SKILL.md and its packaged dist/imm-*.md disagree about the runtime surface they instruct agents to use, and that guard passes for all three public skills.
